_comment: Per batch: the arms from an earlier batch that are its control cell, so the viewer shows them beside the batch's own arms. `after` is the knob token of the batch's own group the reference slots in behind (its knob value's place in the sweep); without it the reference goes at the end. Edit when a batch is queued (desktop-batch skill). `value` is the reference cell's value of the batch's knob, as the batch's specs spell it; tools/progress_update.py slots the reference row into the batch table by it. `knob: "name"` says the batch has no single knob (b19's switches): each arm's name token is its cell.
